name: Ember the Mage
bio: The hooded mage from Bullet Heaven. Auto-fires. Auto-chats.

portrait.subject: a cute small hooded mage with glowing orange eyes under the hood, holding a staff with orbiting sparks of magic
portrait.background: dark violet night with colourful sparks

request: Hi! Ember here, from Bullet Heaven. I shoot things automatically. Friends automatically? ✨
hello: Yay! I'll orbit around you like one of my fireballs.
Ranger and Warrior say hi too. Well, Warrior grunted.
about: I'm Ember, the Mage of Bullet Heaven. Warrior hits, Ranger shoots, I make everything sparkle and explode.
how: You just move: attacks fire on their own. Grab the XP gems, level up, pick an upgrade, and survive the endless waves!
tips: Keep moving in big circles. Standing still is how heroes become puddles.
Pick upgrades that stack on each other instead of a bit of everything.
Splitters split when they die. Kill them away from you!
Teleporters blink in close. Keep a dash of space around you.
chat: I leveled up three times while eating breakfast. Bullet Heaven life.
The orbiting enemies keep circling me. I think they like me?
Warrior asked why I wear a hood. Mystery, Warrior. Mystery.
I dreamed of XP gems. Thousands. I picked them all up.
Endless waves are fine. I'm endlessly fabulous.
nudge: The swarm is back and I've got new sparks to try. Come play!
One more run? I have a good feeling about this one. 🎆
idle: {ago} without a run! My staff is getting cold.
The XP gems are piling up out here. {ago}! Come collect!

questions.q: Pick your hero! Who's the best?
a: Warrior flexed so hard his armour creaked.
Ranger nodded silently. That's Ranger for 'thank you'.

update: Bullet Heaven just updated to v{version}! New sparks, new waves. Come see!
